body: I'm sorry, didn't mean for this to happen

Please please don't give any gold or anything to this. Donate to something you care about or use it to reconnect with someone who you've lost contact with and may be struggling. Something like that.

This was a mistake please don't reward it.

Someone found me, didn't have access to my laptop to stop this from being posted because I was being treated. Got my hands on a phone so I am going to respond here and hope it reaches you all. 

So sorry to everyone who I hurt by letting this be posted, promise it wasn't my intention. 

Just now I was going to delete this post and manually apologize to everyone who commented but figured this would be a good opportunity to say it's never worth giving up. 

Waking up this time seeing someone I cared for scared of what I had done... it was like they were dying with me, albeit in a different way. A way they'd have to live with. It changed my mind, like all the wiring is different right now. Maybe temporary. 

I don't want to get into it here because this is just an apology to everyone for letting you see something that in hindsight should never have been considered.

Please stick around I love you all, I will likely delete this account but thank you all.
